title: AW27 Women's Colour Stories
summary: Four AW27 women's colour stories: Painted by Time, New Neutrals, Pink for All and Living Green.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Première Vision's colour preview opens with "grayed mid-tones, as if patinated by time", with purples "taking center stage"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Neutrals shift: grey toward greyish blue, khaki toward taupe, green or copper, navy toward turquoise or purplish tones<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pink and mauve are becoming gender-neutral, reaching menswear and even junior sweatshirts<sup>[2]</sup>
- Première Vision's AW27 theme "Living Matter" puts materials "at the center", with materials "infused with memory"<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Painted by Time
sections.body: Deep violet, tannic bordeaux, waxy ochre and tinted black, softened as if by old varnish, for velvet and patinated leather.

sections.heading: New Neutrals
sections.body: Tinted black, mushroom, greyed blue and copper khaki: neutrals with colour inside.

sections.heading: Pink for All
sections.body: Dusty mauve and silicone pink in tailoring and knits.

sections.heading: Living Green
sections.body: Sage and moss with copper khaki for natural fibres.
